output.reason: No unit gives a script for estimating an out-of-network visit cost. The closest, U-BEN-COST-001-02, is the disclaimer for in-network visit estimates; it only says that out-of-network status can change what the member pays. Units 001-01 and 001-03 through 001-09 cover in-network quoting steps, referrals and illustrative copays. The E-CB units cover callbacks.
